1.name: iGrind — Game monster tracker
1.objective: Track monster spawns in real-time across game servers
1.business: Built a three-service platform (Flask API + Streamlit UI + automated scraper) that scrapes monster spawn coordinates from iScout in real-time. Uses a Socket.IO browserless path with a Playwright/Chromium fallback, posting batches to an internal API that upserts/deletes spawns transactionally. Users can search monsters across servers, bookmark spawns, and track despawns. Includes a full admin panel with user management, scraper health monitoring, and runtime config editing. Dockerized end-to-end with scheduled scraping, session reuse, and automatic failover.

2.name: Savings portfolio monitoring
2.business: Read ticker symbols from Yahoo of my personal investments (stock & etfs), as broker updates from my bank had a very low frequency (daily), allowing to monitor the market in real-time.

3.name: Job search automation
3.business: Automated web scrapping in several job-sites to gather jobs that best matched my profile. Managed to get an opportunity at ECB.

4.name: Crypto monitoring
4.objective: Monitor crypto currencies and extract indicators for business opportunities
4.business: Generated a web scrapping script for coinbase that run in a scheduled manner and updated a database, calculating derivated indicators for each crypto-currency on a daily basis. This allowed to detect potential short-term growing cryptos. The best outcome was detecting Dogecoin.
